title: Manager Instruction
description: Instruction from ChatGPT manager to CLI executor. Encodes the command, the task, model selection, memory action, and constraints. Every instruction is a complete control signal — the executor needs no additional context.

reply_to.description: ID of the executor report this instruction responds to, or null

command.description: The control command. Determines how the executor interprets the instruction.

decision.description: The decision encoded by this instruction. Aligns with command.

instruction.description: What the executor should do. Clear, specific, actionable.

instruction_detail.description: Additional context, rationale, or guidance for the instruction

success_criteria.description: Explicit criteria the manager will use to verify completion

constraints.description: Boundaries the executor must not cross

manager_model.description: Model the manager used (or is using) for this instruction

executor_model.description: Model the executor MUST use for this task

memory_action.description: What the executor should do with context memory before starting

reason.description: Why this model and memory action were chosen

task_timeout_minutes.description: Maximum minutes the executor should spend before reporting status. 0 = no timeout.

test_paths.description: Optional specific test paths to run. If absent, executor decides.
